name: squat-to-stand
description: Human rising from a seat or deep squat without using the hands: lean the trunk forward and flex the hips further (flexion-momentum), shift the weight over the feet with hip flexion and ankle dorsiflexion at their peaks (momentum transfer, seat-off), then extend hips and knees together while the ankle comes back (extension).
sources: Phase timing 0-33-66-100% and start angles hip ~88 deg, knee ~98 deg, ankle dorsiflexion peak ~18 deg: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.03766
Lift-off angles hip 87.7, knee 105.1 deg; peak hip flexion and dorsiflexion in momentum transfer: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1929086
Peak trunk flexion ~59 deg at seat-off (full-flexion strategy): summarised from the sit-to-stand literature search, see docs/architecture.md
Intermediate keyframes are interpolated by hand between these published values; they are a reference shape, not a measured trajectory.
units: degrees; trunkLean forward, hip flexion, knee flexion, ankle dorsiflexion are positive
